turns.text: I was surprised to hear the announcement before the committee vote.
There was pressure to make the deadline, so I made the call.
I know about the deadline. I asked to be consulted because my name is on the decision.
Then perhaps you should have been online all evening.
Brilliant, it's my fault again for having an evening off. You keep doing this. I've had enough of being held responsible for your decisions.

The installer chose the position, not me.

Walk around the other side instead of making a fuss.
Don't tell me I'm overreacting. You never listen when the problem affects me. This is unacceptable.

I thought everything by the door was ready to go. I'm sorry.
Some were letters, so this isn't just about buying replacements.
I understand. I've called the shop and they have kept the boxes aside. I'll collect them now and label things with you next time.
I still feel shaken, but I appreciate you finding them. That would help. Let's try sorting them together before another pickup.

I thought you wanted it raised, but I should have asked you first.
Raising the issue was okay; naming me was the part I wasn't ready for.

Thanks for separating those things. I'm still upset, but we can work this out. The clarification would help.

I appreciate the request, but that doesn't resolve today's charge. I still need a decision before I agree to keep the service.

We can move our catch-up if you'd prefer.
